digest.component_or_area: completion evidence banking policy and observer
propositions: The 0707 dense-banking eval was failing because the observer filtered only source=='tool' writes, missing the policy's fallback-sourced snapshot banks that occur within the bounded interval.

System-level boundedness (not model-driven banking etiquette) is the measured contract: durable banks must occur at bounded evidence-response intervals regardless of whether they come from genuine model records or policy fallback snapshots.
The observer's make_observed_upsert must re-scope to record the first durable write of each criterion from any source except seeded=True cache seeds, to align with the ruled system-level contract.
Live run 32575679530 confirmed the system bound holds (fallback snapshots at [2,5,8] with gaps ≤3) while model genuine banks land late at response 6, proving no in-band steering nudge is needed.
Unit test regressions must verify fallback-only transcripts pass, the live-shape (fallbacks+genuine) passes, and genuinely-unbounded transcripts (fallback disabled) fail the oracle.
